desc: Person A's preference never reaches person B (the approver does not see the sponsor's weekly preference).

request.text: From now on show my figures weekly

json.reply: The data behind this project is 3 gold tables, each ready for dashboards: gold_investment_report_benchmark_monthly (Portfolio return, benchmark return and the difference for each month, from recorded values.), with columns benchmark_code, month, portfolio_return, benchmark_return, difference; gold_investment_report_cash_daily (Cash per entity per day, administrator view next to the trading view.), with columns position_date, entity, view_type, cash_usd, status; gold_investment_report_holdings_monthly (Month-end holdings by entity in USD and SGD with the status of each value.), with columns report_month, entity, holding, net_worth_usd, net_worth_sgd, status. You can see 2 dashboards: Monthly investment report in USD and SGD, My dashboard. For the model underneath, how the tables are built and what feeds what, open Build and ask Span. To get a tile, name one of these figures: benchmark_return, cash_usd, difference, net_worth_sgd, net_worth_usd, portfolio_return. I will remember: you like figures by week. You can change or remove this under Settings, What the agents remember about you.

source.said: From now on show my figures weekly
